# Pull Request

## Summary

What does this PR do, in one or two sentences?

## Motivation

Why is this change needed? Link the related issue (for example, `Closes #123`).

## Changes

- Bullet list of the concrete changes.
- Focus on behavior and structure, not line counts.

## Testing

How was this change verified? (CI, manual steps, commands run)
If no tests apply yet, state that explicitly and why.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] My branch is up to date with `main`.
- [ ] Commits are focused and follow the commit conventions.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where relevant.
- [ ] CI passes.

## Documentation Impact

Does this change require documentation updates? If so, list them.

## Breaking Changes

List any breaking changes and the migration path. If none, write "None".

## Screenshots

Attach screenshots or diagrams if applicable. Otherwise, write "N/A".

## Reviewer Notes

Anything reviewers should pay special attention to.
